senses.gloss:
ind.
A particle and prefix of assent or acceptance, as शप्करोति he accepts.

r. 1st cl. (शपति-ते) r. 4th cl. (शप्यति-ते)
1 To revile, to wish evil or imprecations on, to curse, to swear.
2 To take an oath.

m. (-पः)
1 An oath.
2 An imprecation, a curse, cursing.
3 A corpse; also शव.
E.
शप to curse, aff. अच्.

m. (-पः)
1 Oath, affirmation by oath or ordeal.
2 Curse, imprecation.
3 Abuse.
E.
शप to swear, aff. घञ्.

r. 1st cl. (सपति)
1 To be connected.
2 To understand thoroughly.

m. (-थः)
1 An oath, asseveration by oath or ordeal.
2 An imprecation, a curse.
3 Cursing, wishing ill to.
E.
शप to swear, Uṇādi aff. अथ.

n. (-नं)
An oath, confirmation of the truth by oath or ordeal.
2 Abuse, imprecation, cursing, malediction.
E.
शप to curse, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Revilling, imprecating.
2 Swearing.
E.
शप to curse, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Cursed, anathematised.
2 Sworn, taken as an oath.
m. (-प्तः)
A sort of grass, (Saccharum cylindricum).
E.
शप to curse, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Having incurred or suffering under a curse.
E.
शाप, and ग्रस्त seized.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Arising from a curse, being the effect of one.
E.
शाप, and ज born.

m. (-कः)
A peacock.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Freed from a curse.
E.
शाप, and मुक्त released.

n. (-न्तं)
The end of a curse or period of an imprecation.
E.
शाप, and अन्त end.

m. (-स्त्रः)
A Muni, a saint.
E.
शाप a curse, and अस्त्र a weapon; a curse denounced by such a personage, being formidable even to the deities.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sworn, made to take an oath.
E.
शप to swear, causal v., क्त aff.

m. (-रः)
Deliverance from a curse or its effects.
E.
शाप, and उद्धार extricating.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
1 Winged.
2 Having a side or party.
m. (-क्षः)
A partisan, a follower, an adherent, one of the same side or party.
E.
स for समान same, and पक्ष party.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Distressed, afflicted.
m. (-तः)
A wounded deer or other animal.
E.
स for सह with, पत्र the leaf, the barb of the arrow, and कृत made; also सपत्राकृत, &c. being metaphorically applied to distress or pain in general.

n. (-णं)
Excessive pain: see the last.

f. (-तिः)
Agony, affliction, excessive pain or distress: see the last.

m. (-त्वः)
An enemy, an adversary.
f. (-त्वी)
A woman whose husband has other wives.
E.
स for समान the same, पति a husband, ङीष् aff. and नुक् augment, अच् added for the masc. form.

m. (-रिः)
A sort of bambu, (Bambusa spinosa.)

ind.
1 Instantly, in a moment, at the moment.
2 Quickly, swiftly.
E.
सम् before पद to go, इन् aff. and the nasal rejected.

f. (-र्य्या)
Worship, reverence.
E.
सपर Kaṇḍvādi root, said to imply worship, यक् and टाप् affs.

m. (-ण्डः)
A kinsman, especially one connected by the offering of the funeral cake to either or all of the manes of the father, grandfather, and great-grandfather, and their wives respectively, as sprung from them in directly collateral lines; the relationship stops with every fourth person, as the fifth cannot perform the offering of a cake to the father even of the deceased. The following are enumerated as Sapiṇḍas; the son, son's son, and son's grandson; widow, daughter and daughter's son; the father, the mother, the brother, brother's son, and brother's grandson; father's daughter's son; father's brother's son and grandson; paternal grandfather's daughter's son; paternal grandfather; paternal grandmother, paternal grandfather's brother, brother's son and grandson; and lastly the great grandfather's daughter's son: these all present oblations in which the deceased is either included, or may participate: other enumerations, including the oblations he was bound to offer, &c. extend the connection of Sapiṇḍa to seven persons both in an ascending or descending line.
E.
स for समान common, and पिण्ड ball of meat, &c. offered to the manes of the deceased ancestors, at the Śrāddhas performed in honor of them.

n. (-णं)
Offering food to the deceased relatives called Sapiṇḍas: see the last.
2 Investing a person with the rights of relationship, indicated by offering the funeral cake.
E.
सपिण्ड, करण making, च्चि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Comprehended in the relationship of Sapiṇḍa or offering of a common cake.
E.
सपिण्ड, and कृत made, च्चि augment.

f. (-तिः)
Drinking together.
E.
स for सह with, and पा to drink, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-कः-का or -की-कं)
1 Seven.
2 Seventh.
n. (-कं)
A collection of seven stanzas of the Ṛg Vedas.
f. (-की)
A woman's girdle.
E.
सप्तन् seven, (strings, &c.) कन् and घातु or ङीप् affs.

m. (-ह्वः)
AGNI, or fire.
E.
सप्त seven, and जिह्वा a tongue or flame.

m. (-लः)
AGNI or fire.
E.
सप्त seven, ज्वाला a flame.

m. (-न्तुः)
A sacrifice, an offering or oblation.
E.
सप्त seven, (prayers, or the tongues of AGNI,) तन to spread, aff. तु.

f. sing. (-तिः)
Seventy.
du. (-ती)
Two seventies.
plu. (-तयः)
Many seventies.
E.
सप्तन् seven, डति aff.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
Seventeenth.
E.
सप्त, दशन् seventeen, aff. डट्.

mfn. plu. (-श)
Seventeen.
E.
सप्तन seven, and दशन् ten.

m. (-तिः)
AGNI or fire.
E.
सप्त seven, दीधिति a ray of light.

ind.
In seven ways.
E.
सप्तन् seven, धा aff.

m. (-तुः)
The seven parts of the body, or chyle, blood, flesh, adeps, marrow, bone, and semen.
E.
सप्त seven, and घातु element.

mfn. plu. only (सप्त)
Seven.
E.
षप to be collected, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्, तुट् augment.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं)
Seven-leaved.
m. (-र्णः)
A tree, (Alstonia scholaris.)
n. (-र्णं)
A sort of sweetmeat, made of the expressed juice of the grape, pomegranate and date, with sugar, spices, honey, and Ghee.
E.
सप्त seven, and पर्ण a leaf.

f. (-सूः)
The mother of seven children.
E.
सप्त seven, पुत्त्र a child, and सू mother.

plu. (-तयः)
The seven constituent parts of a kingdom, or prince, minister, city, country, treasure, force, and ally or friend.
E.
सप्त, and प्रकृति constituent.

m. (-द्रः)
The Sirisha tree, (Acacia Sirisa.)
E.
सप्त seven, and भद्र auspicious.

mfn. (-मः-मी-मं)
Seventh.
f. (-मी)
The seventh day of the fortnight.
E.
सप्तन् seven, डतम aff.

m. plu. (-क्ताः)
The seven external parts of the body of a red colour, or the palms of the hands, the soles of the feet, the corners of the eyes, the tongue, the palate, the lips and nails.
E.
सप्त seven, and रक्त red or blood.

n. (-त्रं)
A period of seven nights.
E.
सप्त, and रात्र for रात्रि night.

m. plu. (-र्षयः)
The constellation Ursa Major, the seven stars of which are the seven great saints, MARĪCI, ATRI, AṄGIRAS, PULASTYA, PULAHA, KRATU, and VASIṢṬHA.
E.
सप्त seven, and ऋषि a sage.

f. (-ला)
1 Double jasmine, (J. zambac fl. multiplicatis.)
2 A plant, commonly Carmaghās.
3 Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.)
4 A shrub, (Abrus precatorius.)
E.
सप्त seven, (leaves, &c.) ला to get or have, aff. क.

m. (-प्तिः)
The sun.
E.
सप्त seven, and सप्ति a horse.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Of seven cubits.
2 Having seven hands, &c.
E.
सप्त, and हस्त a hand.

m. (-वः)
The planet SATURN.
E.
सप्त seven, अंशु a ray of light, पुङ्गव eminent.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Having seven members or parts.
E.
सप्त, and अङ्ग a part.

mfn. (-र्च्चिः)
Evil-eyed.
m. (-र्च्चिः)
1 AGNI or fire.
2 The planet SATURN.
E.
सप्त seven, and अर्च्चिस् a flame.

m. (-श्वः)
The sun.
E.
सप्त seven, and अश्व a horse.

n. (-स्रं)
A heptagon.
E.
सप्त, and अस्र an angle.

n. (-हं)
A week.
E.
सप्त, and अह for अहन् a day.

m. (-प्तिः)
A horse.
E.
षप to be collected, (in a troop,) ति aff.

m. (-त्न्यः)
An enemy.
n. (-त्न्यं)
Plurality of wives, or the condition of the wife of one who has other wives.
E.
सपत्नी a fellow-wife, or सपत्न an enemy, ष्यञ् pleonasm or aff. of the abstract.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
Having progeny.
E.
स with, अपत्य offspring.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Faulty, offending.
E.
स with, अपराध fault.

n. (-ण्ड्यं)
Consanguinity, kindred, connexion, by presenting obsequial offerings to the same persons.
E.
सपिण्ड, and ष्यञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
Friendship.
E.
सप्त seven, पद a step or pace, and खञ् aff.; to be formed with any with whom seven paces are walked together.

mfn. (-षः-षी-षं)
Extending to seven generations, &c.
E.
सप्त seven, पुरुष male, अञ् aff.
